concept.label: Incarnation
concept.scope-note: The Christian theological topic of the incarnation. A topic assignment describes a resource's discussion rather than endorsing every claim in it.

concept.label: Salvation
concept.scope-note: Discussion of salvation; narrower concepts can distinguish particular doctrines and interpretations.

concept.label: Creation
concept.scope-note: Discussion of creation. The concept does not itself specify a chronology or interpretive position.

concept.label: The Flood
Noah's Flood
concept.scope-note: The flood narrative associated with Noah in Genesis 6–9, without asserting a particular interpretation of geographical extent.

concept.label: Global Flood interpretation
Global flood
concept.scope-note: Interpretations of the Genesis flood as global. This narrower topic must not be merged into a synonym asserting that every Flood resource takes that position.

concept.label: Spiritual warfare
concept.scope-note: Discussion of spiritual struggle and warfare language in biblical and theological resources.

concept.label: Armor of God
Armour of God
concept.scope-note: The armor metaphor in Ephesians 6 and resources discussing it.
